why: T41's done_when asks for a 3-epoch CPU run in which `best` describes one epoch and the checkpoint the artifact names holds that same epoch. This records the run and the three checks, including the one that is vacuous here.

best.target_note: hit_target is measured on the gate metric, at that metric's own bar (0.5; 0.5 for bond_exact_type, 0.400 for combined, 0.8 for gen_validity, args.target_decode_ratio for decode_ratio). decode_ratio is reported but is not a chemistry metric (see decode_ratio_caveat).

early_stop_control.gating_note: bond_type_f1 degraded to bond_exact_type (its own input was unmeasured); bond_exact_type_rate is at its floor 0.000 over n=16 scored complexes

selection.reason: bond_exact_type has 1 distinct value(s) over 3 epoch(s) (['0']), so its argmax ranks nothing; the final epoch is selected instead

self_consistent.claim: best.epoch == best.bond_fields_from_epoch and epochs_mixed is false

named_file.claim: the file provenance.checkpoint names embeds epoch == best.epoch

epoch_named_write.claim: the tagged save reproduces the selected checkpoint byte for byte
epoch_named_write.note: the only improvement was epoch 0, so `_epoch0.pt` is the only tagged file; it is byte-identical to `seed0.pt`, which is what 'same in-memory state' has to mean

row_matches_best.claim: best's bond fields equal per_epoch_metrics[best.epoch]'s row
row_matches_best.vacuous_because: every bond metric reads 0.000 at all three epochs on a 64-cloud 3-epoch CPU smoke, so equality holds for any row. This check cannot distinguish the epochs here; the synthetic-row tests in molmetal/tests/test_wfa113_best_block_one_epoch.py carry that weight.

honest_limits: The gate still degraded: `early_stop_metric: bond_type_f1` was requested but bond_type_macro_f1_pooled read 0.000 at every epoch, so resolve_early_stop_criterion fell through to bond_exact_type (also 0.000). That is a real property of a 3-epoch smoke, not a wiring fault — the same code path on the 36-epoch gcv36 artifact returns bond_type_macro_f1, which is what test_gcv36_combined_gate_is_not_a_constant asserts.

The run therefore exercises the DEGENERATE selection path: the gate's argmax was epoch 0 and resolve_selection overrode it to epoch 2. That is the case T41 was written for (budget36 named an epoch-0 file), but it means the non-degenerate path — `_epoch{N}.pt` chosen as `checkpoint` — is covered only by the unit tests, not by this run.
No quality claim. 64 clouds, 3 epochs, decode_ratio 1.000 is the loose-atom artefact.
